hero.title: The CMS built like an archival index.
hero.description: Structure your content with the precision of a museum catalog. Every entry is a specimen — typed, tagged, and preserved for permanent reference.

featuresSection.title: Precision in Publishing
featuresSection.description: We discarded the generic SaaS gloss and built an interface that respects your content like a curator handles artifacts.

feature1.title: Structured Archives
feature1.description: Organize content entries exactly like physical index cards — with rigid schema, typed fields, and immutable metadata.

feature2.title: Rigid Schema
feature2.description: Define robust relationships using GraphQL. Every field is typed, validated, and documented at the schema level.

feature3.title: Content Specimens
feature3.description: Every piece of data is treated as a permanent artifact — versioned, timestamped, and preserved for long-term reference.
